meta.title: x/tools/gopls/internal/analysis/modernize: waitgroup modernizer makes a complete mess of it
meta.fix_ref: golang/tools@6ebfec2837bb (gopls/internal/analysis: fix waitgroup modernizer formatting; CL 698155)
meta.build_notes: go install golang.org/x/tools/gopls@<version> with the local Go (go1.27.1), which builds both; the server runs the local go command, whose standard library has sync.WaitGroup.Go (Go 1.25+). The issue was reported 2025-07-22 against the analyzer at x/tools master; v0.20.0 was tagged 2025-07-28 with the waitgroup pass (modernize.go calls waitgroup(pass)); the fix merged 2025-08-21, v0.21.0 was tagged 2025-12-05.
meta.notes: The pre-fix fix text printed the receiver expression s.wg as a Go value ('&{s wg}') instead of formatting the source expression, producing invalid syntax.

settings_note: The modernize analyzer is on by default in both builds.

files.source: issue body, first code block (output of 'cat b.go', the shell prompt line omitted)

files.note: a module around the file (the reporter ran in the x/tools module); go 1.25, the release that added WaitGroup.Go, like the file's build constraint

repro.steps: Open b.go. The waitgroup pass reports the s.wg.Add(1) / go func(){...; s.wg.Done()}() pattern ('Goroutine creation can be simplified using WaitGroup.Go'). Apply its fix ('Simplify by using WaitGroup.Go'). Reported (with the modernize command): the result '&{s wg}.Go(func() {' does not parse. Probe: the edited text must have no parse error that the original did not have.
